angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 541,950 km at 57.45 pc = 0.13 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 17.4049 +/- 0.0137 mas (same row, RUWE 1.13): 57.45 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.779 +/- 0.053 solar radii from Oddo et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-444 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....165..134O/abstract): 541,950 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.96 +/- 0.13 solar masses from Oddo et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-444 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....165..134O/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5225 +/- 70 K from Oddo et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-444 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....165..134O/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Oddo et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-444 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....165..134O/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-444.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.637, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-444 (pscomppars): spectral type K1/2 V, from Oddo et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....165..134O/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-444 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.08 dex, from Oddo et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....165..134O/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-444 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.41794, from TICv8 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-444 (pscomppars): age 0.57 Gyr, from Oddo et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....165..134O/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-444 (pscomppars): rotation period 13 d, from Oddo et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....165..134O/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
